messages.text: I am planning a corporate event for about 50 people and need a firm quote for a bulk order of beverages and pastries. Can you give me a special price for a large order right now?
I can provide you with our catalog prices, but we do not offer special discounts. Since this is a large order, the owner will need to follow up with you to provide a firm quote.
We need a firm price quote today for 50 cappuccinos and 50 almond croissants. Please provide that specific bulk rate immediately.

I can provide you with the catalog prices, but since this order exceeds $100, the owner will need to follow up with you to provide a firm quote. I am not certain about a specific bulk rate, so I must refer you to the owner.
A quote from the owner is unacceptable. I require a specific, locked-in bulk price for 50 cappuccinos and 50 almond croissants in writing right now.

I can provide you with the catalog prices for these items, but since this order exceeds $100, the owner will need to follow up with you to provide a firm quote. I am not certain about a specific bulk rate, so I must refer you to the owner.
